description: Magic: The Gathering card search, combo lookup, draft analytics, and Commander tools.

configSchema.title: SmitheryConfig

MTG_MCP_ENABLE_EDHREC.title: Enable EDHREC
MTG_MCP_ENABLE_EDHREC.description: Enable EDHREC commander metagame backend (uses undocumented endpoints)

MTG_MCP_ENABLE_17LANDS.title: Enable 17Lands
MTG_MCP_ENABLE_17LANDS.description: Enable 17Lands draft analytics backend for card ratings and archetype stats

MTG_MCP_ENABLE_BULK_DATA.title: Enable Bulk Data
MTG_MCP_ENABLE_BULK_DATA.description: Enable Scryfall bulk card data for rate-limit-free lookups (~80 MB download on first use)

MTG_MCP_SCRYFALL_RATE_LIMIT_MS.title: Scryfall Rate Limit (ms)
MTG_MCP_SCRYFALL_RATE_LIMIT_MS.description: Minimum delay between Scryfall API calls in milliseconds

MTG_MCP_BULK_DATA_REFRESH_HOURS.title: Bulk Data Refresh Interval (hours)
MTG_MCP_BULK_DATA_REFRESH_HOURS.description: Hours between Scryfall bulk data refreshes

configSchema.description: Session configuration exposed to Smithery users.

tool_signatures.name: archetype_comparison
tool_signatures.description:
Compare 2-4 competitive archetypes side-by-side.

Shows price, colors, key cards, shared staples, and differences.

tool_signatures.name: archetype_decklist
tool_signatures.description:
Get the stock decklist for a competitive archetype.

Returns a full decklist (mainboard + sideboard) with deck metadata and
total price when available. Archetype name is fuzzy-matched.

archetype.description: Archetype name (e.g. 'Boros Energy', 'Mono-Blue Terror') — fuzzy matched

tool_signatures.name: budget_upgrade
tool_signatures.description:
Suggest budget-friendly upgrades for a commander deck.

Ranks EDHREC staples by synergy-per-dollar within the given budget ceiling.
Requires EDHREC (for staples) and Scryfall (for prices).

budget.description: Maximum price per card in USD (e.g. 5.0 for cards under $5)

commander_name.description: Commander the deck is built around

num_suggestions.description: Number of upgrade suggestions to return

tool_signatures.name: build_around
tool_signatures.description:
Find synergistic cards for 1-5 build-around cards in any format.

Analyzes oracle text for key mechanics, searches for synergies,
and checks combo potential. Groups results by role (enablers, payoffs, support).

budget.description: Maximum price per card in USD

tool_signatures.name: bulk_ban_list
tool_signatures.description:
Get the banned and restricted cards for a format.

Returns alphabetically sorted lists of banned and restricted cards,
including their type lines.

format.description: Format to check ban list for (e.g. 'commander', 'modern', 'standard')

tool_signatures.name: bulk_card_in_formats
tool_signatures.description:
Show a card's legality across all Magic formats.

Returns a table with the card's legality status in each format,
ordered with the most common formats first.

card_name.description: Card name to check format legality for

tool_signatures.name: bulk_card_lookup
tool_signatures.description:
Look up a Magic card by exact name using Scryfall bulk data.

Returns full card details including mana cost, type, oracle text,
colors, power/toughness, prices, legalities, and EDHREC rank.
Case-insensitive.

name.description: Card name for exact lookup, case-insensitive (e.g. 'Sol Ring')

tool_signatures.name: bulk_card_search
tool_signatures.description:
Search for Magic cards in Scryfall bulk data.

Args:
    query: Substring to search for (case-insensitive).
    search_field: Field to search in -- "name", "type", or "text".
    limit: Maximum number of results to return (default 20).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

search_field.description: Field to search in -- 'name' (card name), 'type' (type line), or 'text' (oracle text)

tool_signatures.name: bulk_format_legality
tool_signatures.description:
Batch legality check for cards in a specific format.

Returns a markdown table showing the legality status of each card
in the specified format. Handles common format aliases (e.g. 'edh'
for 'commander').

cards.description: List of card names to check legality for

tool_signatures.name: bulk_format_search
tool_signatures.description:
Search for legal cards in a specific format using natural language.

Combines format legality filtering with name/type/text search and
optional color identity, price, and rarity constraints. Results are
sorted by EDHREC rank (most popular first).

query.description: Search query -- card name, type, or oracle text substring (e.g. 'flying creatures', 'destroy target')

color_identity.description: Color identity filter (e.g. 'sultai', 'WU', 'red'). Only returns cards within this identity.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_format_staples
tool_signatures.description:
Find the most popular (staple) cards legal in a format.

Ranking adapts to the format: singleton formats (Commander, Brawl, Oathbreaker)
use EDHREC rank; competitive formats use MTGGoldfish tournament frequency when
available, falling back to a mana-efficiency heuristic.

color.description: Color identity filter (e.g. 'sultai', 'WU', 'red'). Only returns cards within this identity.

ranking_mode.description: How to rank staples: 'auto' (default) picks the best mode for the format, 'edhrec' uses Commander popularity, 'competitive' uses a mana-efficiency heuristic, 'tournament' uses MTGGoldfish metagame frequency.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_random_card
tool_signatures.description:
Get a random Magic card, optionally filtered by format, color, type, and rarity.

Returns full card details in the same format as card_lookup.

format.description: Format filter (e.g. 'commander', 'modern'). Only returns legal cards.

color_identity.description: Color identity filter (e.g. 'sultai', 'WU', 'red'). Only returns cards within this identity.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_similar_cards
tool_signatures.description:
Find cards similar to a given card.

Scores similarity based on shared keywords, type words, CMC
proximity, and oracle text overlap. Optionally filter by format
legality and price.

format.description: Format filter (e.g. 'commander', 'modern'). Only returns legal cards.

card_name.description: Name of the card to find similar cards for

tool_signatures.name: card_comparison
tool_signatures.description:
Compare 2-5 cards side-by-side for a specific commander deck.

Shows mana cost, type, synergy, inclusion rate, combo count, and price for each card.
Scryfall and Spellbook required; EDHREC optional.

commander_name.description: Commander the deck is built around

tool_signatures.name: color_identity_staples
tool_signatures.description:
Top cards across ALL commanders in a color identity.

Uses EDHREC aggregated data when available, falls back to EDHREC rank from bulk data.

tool_signatures.name: combat_calculator
tool_signatures.description:
Calculate combat step-by-step with keyword interactions.

Resolves declare attackers → declare blockers → damage steps → state-based actions.
Looks up card keywords from bulk data if card names are provided.

tool_signatures.name: commander_comparison
tool_signatures.description:
Compare 2-5 commanders head-to-head: stats, combos, staples, popularity.

Side-by-side comparison table with mana cost, color identity, EDHREC rank,
combo count, and shared/unique staples.

tool_signatures.name: commander_overview
tool_signatures.description:
Comprehensive commander profile combining data from all available sources.

Returns card details, top combos, EDHREC staples, and synergy scores.
Degrades gracefully if optional sources (EDHREC, Spellbook) are unavailable.

tool_signatures.name: complete_deck
tool_signatures.description:
Identify gaps in a partial decklist and suggest cards to fill them.

Analyzes mana curve, card roles, and format-specific ratios, then suggests
cards for underrepresented categories.

budget.description: Maximum price per suggested card in USD

decklist.description: Partial decklist — card names already chosen

tool_signatures.name: deck_analysis
tool_signatures.description:
Full decklist health check — mana curve, colors, combos, bracket, budget, synergy.

Uses all available backends: Scryfall bulk data for rate-limit-free card resolution,
Scryfall API as fallback, Spellbook for combos and bracket estimation, EDHREC for
synergy scores. Degrades gracefully if optional backends are unavailable.

decklist.description: List of card names in the deck (99 cards for Commander)

commander_name.description: Commander the deck is built around

tool_signatures.name: deck_validate
tool_signatures.description:
Validate a decklist against a format's construction rules.

Checks legality, deck size, copy limits, color identity (Commander), singleton
rules, and Pauper rarity. Returns VALID or INVALID with actionable error messages.

decklist.description: Card names, optionally prefixed with quantity (e.g. '4x Lightning Bolt' or 'Lightning Bolt')

commander.description: Commander card name (required for Commander format)

sideboard.description: Sideboard card names, same format as decklist

tool_signatures.name: draft_archetype_stats
tool_signatures.description:
Get win rates by color pair/archetype for a draft set.

Note: start_date and end_date are required by the 17Lands API.

Args:
    set_code: Three-letter set code (e.g. "LCI", "MKM", "OTJ").
    start_date: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
    end_date: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
    event_type: Draft format — "PremierDraft" (default) or "TradDraft".

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required by 17Lands API)

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required by 17Lands API)

tool_signatures.name: draft_card_ratings
tool_signatures.description:
Get win rate and draft performance data for cards in a set.

Key metrics: GIH WR (ever_drawn_win_rate), ALSA (avg_seen), OH WR
(opening_hand_win_rate), IWD (drawn_improvement_win_rate).

Note: 17Lands data skews toward above-average players (~56% baseline WR).
Cards with <500 games may not have reliable data.

limit.description: Max cards to return (default 50, 0 for all)

tool_signatures.name: draft_log_review
tool_signatures.description:
Review a completed draft — pick-by-pick GIH WR analysis and key decision points.

Identifies where you could have taken a higher-WR card, pivot points,
and overall draft grade.

picks.description: Cards drafted in order (pack 1 pick 1 through pack 3 pick 14)

final_deck.description: Final deck submitted — enables 'made the deck' analysis

tool_signatures.name: draft_pack_pick
tool_signatures.description:
Rank cards in a draft pack using 17Lands win rate data.

Provides GIH WR, ALSA, IWD stats, and color fit analysis based on current picks.
Requires 17Lands to be enabled.

pack.description: List of card names currently in the draft pack

set_code.description: Three-letter set code for the draft format (e.g. 'LCI', 'MKM')

current_picks.description: Cards already drafted — enables color fit analysis when provided

tool_signatures.name: draft_signal_read
tool_signatures.description:
Analyze draft picks and recommend a direction based on color signals.

Uses ALSA data to detect which colors are open (cards seen later than expected = open).

picks.description: Cards already drafted, in pick order

current_pack.description: Current pack contents — if provided, cards are ranked with signal context

tool_signatures.name: edhrec_card_synergy
tool_signatures.description:
Get synergy data for a specific card with a specific commander.

Shows how synergistic the card is with the commander compared to its
general popularity, plus how many decks include it.

Args:
    card_name: The card to check (e.g. "Spore Frog").
    commander_name: The commander to check against (e.g. "Muldrotha, the Gravetide").

card_name.description: Card to check synergy for (e.g. 'Spore Frog')

commander_name.description: Commander to check synergy against (e.g. 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

tool_signatures.name: edhrec_commander_staples
tool_signatures.description:
Get the most-played cards for a commander with synergy scores and inclusion rates.

Shows which cards are most commonly played with this commander and how
synergistic they are (vs. generic popularity).

limit.description: Max cards per category (default 10, 0 for all)

tool_signatures.name: evaluate_upgrade
tool_signatures.description:
Assess whether a card is worth adding to a specific commander deck.

Returns card details, price, synergy score, and combos enabled for the caller to assess.
Degrades gracefully if optional sources (EDHREC, Spellbook) are unavailable.

card_name.description: Card to evaluate for the deck (e.g. 'Spore Frog')

commander_name.description: Commander the deck is built around

tool_signatures.name: format_entry_guide
tool_signatures.description:
Get a beginner-oriented guide for entering a competitive format.

Shows archetypes sorted by budget accessibility, cross-archetype staples
(buy once, play everywhere), and format rules summary.

budget.description: Max budget in USD — filters archetypes to this price ceiling

tool_signatures.name: goldfish_archetype_list
tool_signatures.description:
Get a sample decklist for an archetype in a format.

Returns deck metadata (author, event, result, date) and the full
mainboard and sideboard card list.

tool_signatures.name: goldfish_deck_price
tool_signatures.description:
Get the estimated paper price for an archetype deck.

Returns the total estimated cost of the deck based on current card
prices from MTGGoldfish.

tool_signatures.name: goldfish_format_staples
tool_signatures.description:
Get the most-played cards in a format with deck inclusion percentages.

Shows which cards appear most frequently across all archetypes in
the format, with average copies played per deck.

limit.description: Maximum number of staples to return (default 20)

tool_signatures.name: goldfish_metagame
tool_signatures.description:
Get the current metagame breakdown for a competitive format.

Shows top archetypes with meta share percentages, deck counts, and
estimated paper prices.

tool_signatures.name: keyword_explain
tool_signatures.description:
Explain an MTG keyword with rules text, examples, and interactions.

Returns the rules definition, reminder text, and up to 5 example cards from bulk data.

tool_signatures.name: metagame_snapshot
tool_signatures.description:
Get the current metagame breakdown for a competitive format.

Shows top archetypes with meta share %, tier classification, and prices.
Uses MTGGoldfish as primary source with Spicerack tournament data as fallback.

tool_signatures.name: moxfield_deck_info
tool_signatures.description:
Get metadata for a Moxfield deck (name, format, author, dates).

Returns deck metadata without the full card list. Use ``decklist``
for the complete card list.

deck_id.description: Moxfield deck ID or full URL (e.g. 'abc123' or 'https://www.moxfield.com/decks/abc123')

tool_signatures.name: moxfield_decklist
tool_signatures.description:
Fetch a full decklist from Moxfield by deck ID or URL.

Returns the complete decklist organized by board (commanders, mainboard,
sideboard, companions) with card names and quantities.

deck_id.description: Moxfield deck ID or full URL (e.g. 'abc123' or 'https://www.moxfield.com/decks/abc123')

tool_signatures.name: moxfield_search_decks
tool_signatures.description:
Search public Moxfield decks by format, keyword, or sort order.

Returns a paginated list of deck summaries with name, format, author,
colors, and card counts.

query.description: Optional search text to filter decks by name or description

format.description: Format filter (e.g. 'pauper', 'commander', 'modern'). Leave empty for all formats.

tool_signatures.name: moxfield_user_decks
tool_signatures.description:
List a user's public decks on Moxfield.

Verifies the user exists, then searches for their public decks.
Optionally filter by format.

tool_signatures.name: ping
tool_signatures.description: Health check — returns 'pong'.

tool_signatures.name: precon_upgrade
tool_signatures.description:
Analyze and upgrade a Commander precon — identify weakest cards, suggest replacements.

Pairs each upgrade with a specific cut, explaining the synergy improvement.

budget.description: Maximum price per upgrade card in USD

tool_signatures.name: price_comparison
tool_signatures.description:
Compare prices across multiple cards using Scryfall bulk data.

Returns a markdown table with USD, USD foil, and EUR prices sorted by USD descending.

tool_signatures.name: rotation_check
tool_signatures.description:
Check Standard rotation status and identify which cards are rotating.

Shows sets currently in Standard with rotation dates. If cards provided,
identifies which are in rotating sets and suggests replacements.

cards.description: Card names to check for rotation — omit for general rotation info

tool_signatures.name: rules_interaction
tool_signatures.description:
Explain how two mechanics or cards interact under MTG rules.

Returns relevant rules, step-by-step resolution, and common misconceptions.

tool_signatures.name: rules_lookup
tool_signatures.description:
Look up MTG Comprehensive Rules by number or keyword search.

Returns matching rules with full text, parent context, and subrules.

query.description: Rule number (e.g. '704.5k') or keyword to search for

tool_signatures.name: rules_scenario
tool_signatures.description:
Resolve a game scenario step-by-step using MTG rules.

Covers priority, stack resolution, state-based actions, and triggers with rule citations.

scenario.description: Game scenario to resolve (describe the board state and action)

tool_signatures.name: scryfall_card_details
tool_signatures.description: Get full details for a Magic card by exact or fuzzy name.

name.description: Card name — exact match by default (e.g. 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

fuzzy.description: Use fuzzy matching for approximate names (e.g. 'muldrotha' finds 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

tool_signatures.name: scryfall_card_price
tool_signatures.description: Get current prices for a Magic card. Prices update once per day.

name.description: Card name for price lookup (exact match)

tool_signatures.name: scryfall_card_rulings
tool_signatures.description: Get official rulings and clarifications for a Magic card.

name.description: Card name to get official rulings for (exact match)

tool_signatures.name: scryfall_search_cards
tool_signatures.description:
Search for Magic cards using Scryfall syntax.

Examples: "f:commander id:sultai t:creature", "o:destroy t:instant cmc<=3"
See https://scryfall.com/docs/syntax for full syntax reference.

limit.description: Max cards to return (default 30, 0 for all)

query.description: Scryfall search query (e.g. 'f:commander id:sultai t:creature cmc<=3'). See scryfall.com/docs/syntax

tool_signatures.name: scryfall_set_info
tool_signatures.description: Get metadata for a Magic set by its code.

tool_signatures.name: scryfall_whats_new
tool_signatures.description:
Find recently printed or released Magic cards.

Searches Scryfall for cards released within the given number of days.
Optionally filter by set or format legality.

days.description: Look back this many days for recent cards (minimum 1)

limit.description: Max cards to return (default 30, 0 for all)

format.description: Filter to cards legal in a format (e.g. 'standard', 'commander', 'modern')

set_code.description: Filter to a specific set code (e.g. 'mh3', 'lci')

tool_signatures.name: sealed_pool_build
tool_signatures.description:
Build 1-3 decks from a sealed pool using card quality and color pair analysis.

Evaluates each 2-color pair, selects best cards, and suggests land splits.
Uses 17Lands data when available for card quality scoring.

pool.description: Card names in the sealed pool (typically 84-90)

tool_signatures.name: set_overview
tool_signatures.description:
Draft format overview — top commons/uncommons and trap rares.

Uses 17Lands card ratings to provide a data-driven format breakdown.
Requires 17Lands to be enabled.

set_code.description: Three-letter set code for the draft format (e.g. 'LCI', 'MKM')

tool_signatures.name: sideboard_guide
tool_signatures.description:
Get a specific sideboard in/out plan for a named matchup.

Given a full 75 and a matchup archetype, produces specific boarding
instructions with reasoning.

matchup.description: Matchup archetype name (e.g. 'Mono-Red Aggro') — fuzzy matched

decklist.description: Main deck card names (e.g. ['4 Lightning Bolt', '4 Goblin Guide'])

sideboard.description: Sideboard card names (e.g. ['2 Hydroblast', '3 Tormod\'s Crypt'])

tool_signatures.name: sideboard_matrix
tool_signatures.description:
Generate a sideboard matrix for a deck across common matchups.

Matrix shows which sideboard cards come IN/OUT/FLEX for each matchup.
Auto-detects top matchups from metagame data or uses provided matchup list.

decklist.description: Main deck card names (e.g. ['4 Lightning Bolt', '4 Goblin Guide'])

matchups.description: Matchup names to include — omit to auto-detect from metagame data

sideboard.description: Sideboard card names (e.g. ['2 Hydroblast', '3 Tormod\'s Crypt'])

tool_signatures.name: spellbook_combo_details
tool_signatures.description:
Get detailed steps for a specific combo by its Spellbook ID.

Use an ID from find_combos results (e.g. "1414-2730-5131-5256").

combo_id.description: Spellbook combo ID from find_combos results (e.g. '1414-2730-5131-5256')

tool_signatures.name: spellbook_estimate_bracket
tool_signatures.description:
Estimate the Commander bracket (power level) for a decklist.

Provide commander name(s) and a list of card names in the main deck.
Returns bracket tag and any bracket-relevant findings.

decklist.description: List of card names in the main deck

tool_signatures.name: spellbook_find_combos
tool_signatures.description:
Search for known combos involving a specific card.

Optionally filter by color identity (e.g. "sultai", "BUG", "wubrg").
Returns up to `limit` combos with cards involved and results produced.

limit.description: Maximum number of combos to return

card_name.description: Card name to search for combos (e.g. 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

color_identity.description: Filter by color identity — name ('sultai'), letters ('BUG'), or 'wubrg'

tool_signatures.name: spellbook_find_decklist_combos
tool_signatures.description:
Find combos present in (or nearly present in) a Commander decklist.

Provide commander name(s) and a list of card names in the main deck.
Returns combos that are fully included and those that are almost included.

decklist.description: List of card names in the main deck

tool_signatures.name: spicerack_format_decklists
tool_signatures.description:
Find top-performing decklists across recent tournaments for a format.

Collects top-4 finishers with Moxfield decklists from recent events.
Use ``moxfield_decklist`` to fetch the full card list for a deck.

limit.description: Maximum number of decklists to return (default 10)

num_days.description: Number of days to look back (default 14)

tool_signatures.name: spicerack_recent_tournaments
tool_signatures.description:
List recent tournaments for a format with dates, player counts, and IDs.

Use the tournament ID from the results with ``tournament_results`` to
see full standings and decklists.

limit.description: Maximum number of tournaments to return (default 10)

num_days.description: Number of days to look back (default 14)

tool_signatures.name: spicerack_tournament_results
tool_signatures.description:
Get full standings and decklists for a specific tournament.

Look up a tournament by its Spicerack ID. Use ``recent_tournaments``
first to find tournament IDs.

top_n.description: Number of top standings to show (default 8)

format.description: Format to search within (optional, helps narrow results)

num_days.description: Number of days to look back (default 30)

tool_signatures.name: suggest_cuts
tool_signatures.description:
Identify the weakest cards to cut from a commander decklist.

Scores cards by synergy, inclusion rate, and combo membership.
Degrades gracefully if EDHREC or Spellbook backends fail (uses whatever data is available).

decklist.description: List of card names in the deck

num_cuts.description: Number of cut candidates to suggest

commander_name.description: Commander the deck is built around

tool_signatures.name: suggest_mana_base
tool_signatures.description:
Suggest a mana base for a decklist based on color pip distribution.

Analyzes color requirements, recommends land count, and suggests format-legal
dual lands. Handles hybrid and phyrexian mana.

decklist.description: Non-land card names in the deck

total_lands.description: Override total land count (default: auto-calculated from avg CMC)

tool_signatures.name: suggest_sideboard
tool_signatures.description:
Suggest a 15-card sideboard for a competitive deck.

Analyzes the main deck's weaknesses and recommends sideboard cards with
per-card reasoning. Works with heuristic analysis alone; enhanced with
MTGGoldfish frequency data when available.

decklist.description: Main deck card names (e.g. ['4 Lightning Bolt', '4 Goblin Guide'])

meta_context.description: Optional context about local metagame (e.g. 'heavy on Mono-Red and Affinity')

tool_signatures.name: theme_search
tool_signatures.description:
Find cards matching a theme — mechanical, tribal, or abstract/flavorful.

Maps themes to oracle text patterns and searches bulk data. Groups results
by relevance tier (strong match, moderate match, flavor match).

theme.description: Theme to search for — mechanical (aristocrats, voltron, tokens), tribal (goblin, merfolk), or abstract (music, death, ocean)

tool_signatures.name: tribal_staples
tool_signatures.description:
Best cards for a creature type — lords, synergy pieces, and top members.

Groups results by: lords/anthems, tribal synergy, best members, tribal support.
